PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

Cause: Rig repair / equipment downtime while working in Alluvium section.
Remedy: Repaired equipment, resumed operations after downtime.

2015-12-10 | 30 m MD | Dhekiajuli | gas_show | medium | 3.8 hrs NPT
Cause: Background gas rise while drilling Dhekiajuli, connection gas trending up.
Remedy: Increased mud weight slightly, monitored trend, continued drilling.

Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 69 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 19.3 hrs.

2015-12-10 | 499 m MD | Girujan | wellbore_instability | high | 18.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Hole instability / cavings on surface while drilling Girujan, tight hole on connections.
Remedy: Increased mud weight and viscosity, short-tripped to condition hole.

2015-12-10 | 626 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | critical | 85.3 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
Remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

Cause: Following stuck pipe in Girujan, back-off performed, fish left in hole.
Remedy: Ran fishing BHA, latched fish with overshot, recovered string to surface.
